name: data-grid-pagination
title: Data Grid Pagination
author: gridcn
description: Pagination add-on for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridPagination (client mode slices data; server mode is fully controlled) plus a composable <DataGridPaginationBar /> footer (range, page-size select, first/prev/pages/next/last parts) — shadcn-Pagination style, renders a default layout with no children or a custom composition of parts. New user-facing strings live under labels.pagination (see data-grid/labels.ts DataGridPaginationLabels). Zero core changes — purely additive.
